import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

def main():
    # Create the Chrono system
    system = chrono.ChSystem()
    system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))  # Gravity vector

    # Create the Irrlicht visualization
    application = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(system, 'ANCF Cable Beam Simulation', chronoirr.dimension2du(800, 600))
    application.AddTypicalLights()
    application.AddTypicalCamera(chronoirr.ChVectorD(0, 5, 10))  # Camera position
    application.AssetBind()
    application.AssetUpdate()

    # Create the ANCF cable beam
    beam = chrono.ChBodyBeamANCF()
    beam.SetGeometryType(chrono.ChBeamANCF.GEOM_CABLE)  # Cable geometry type
    beam.SetAxisSize(chrono.ChVectorD(0.002, 0.002))  # Cross-sectional diameter (2mm)

    beam.SetNumElements(20)  # Number of elements along the beam

    # Add the beam to the system
    system.Add(beam)

    # Fix the first node to the ground
    link = chrono.ChLinkLockPointBase()
    link.Initialize(beam, chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))  # Constrain the first node's position

    beam.AddAsset(chrono.ChColorAsset(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0, 0)))  # Red color for the beam

    # Simulation parameters
    time_step = 0.001  # Time step for simulation

    # Main simulation loop
